reason: ₹4,999 upfront and then ₹999 every month is too much fixed cost for my small parlour when some months are slow; my register and WhatsApp already work and cost nothing. The cash-drawer checks sound useful, but not enough to pay every month.
objection: ₹999 a month forever is one more fixed bill I have to pay even in slow months, plus ₹4,999 before I see any result, and my staff may not even use it properly.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and a one-time or yearly price I can pay once, or proof from another small salon nearby that the reminders and wallet actually brought back enough customers to cover the cost.
